description: Ground truth for the Odyssey micro-resource catalogues (data/materials/micro-resources-*.jsonc, from EDCD FDevIDs microresources.csv). `counts` pins the size of each catalogue; `records` pins individual entries. `symbol` is Frontier's internal id (the journal id, like ships/modules/materials), `name` is the display name, `category` is one of component / consumable / data / item. Micro resources have no grade or line — they are on-foot resources, not ship-side engineering materials.
